notes.subject: עיני עליך
notes.rationale: KJV 'guide thee with mine eye' vs JPS 'counsel, mine eye being upon thee' — my eye upon you, watching

notes.subject: ו אורך
notes.rationale: 'to throw/flow as water' rendered as बताबइ (teach); some read 'counsel' from a cognate root

notes.subject: to the psalmist / the penitent
notes.rationale: God speaks directly to a single addressee (tú)

notes.subject: divine instruction
notes.rationale: God promises to teach and counsel — summons to be taught

translation: हम तोहनी समझ देबइ आउ ओ रस्ता में तोहनी बताबइ जइसने तूँ जइबइ; हमरी आँख ⟨तोहनी ऊपर⟩ रह के तोहनी सलाह देबइ।
